data.gender_notes: Boopathi is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is the lord of the path or the one who protects the path. This name is derived from the Tamil word 'boo' meaning lord and 'pathi' meaning the one who protects or the one who is the leader. The name Boopathi carries the meaning “Lord of the path” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Boopathi usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the path and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Boopathi is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It is believed that the name is associated with the deity Shiva, who is known as the protector and the destroyer. The name also represents the qualities of power, loyalty, and protection. It is said that those named Boopathi are blessed with these qualities and are able to lead and protect those around them.
